text: {"name":"rf_pll_clock_enable","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Waits for the RF clock status, programs the PLL control value, and applies the register-bit sequence that enables the RF clock.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"rf_ctrl_regs","v1":"pll_cfg_reg","v2":"clock_ctrl_regs","v3":"clock_mask","v4":"pll_tuning_value","v5":"pll_control_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Register in the block at off_10C5A8 updated with mask 0x3BF, bit 0x40, and bits selected by the clock mask."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Control register in the block at off_10C5A8; clears bit 0x40000, sets bit 0x20000, then sets bits in mask 0x18802."},{"offset":48,"meaning":"Status register in the block at off_10C5A8, polled until bits 0x44 equal 0x04."},{"offset":56,"meaning":"Register in the block at off_10C5A4 with bit 0 set."},{"offset":68,"meaning":"Register in the block at off_10C5A8 with bits 0x88000000 set."},{"offset":84,"meaning":"Register in the block at off_10C5A8; clears bit 0x200000, updates bits selected by the clock mask, then clears bit 0x800."},{"offset":256,"meaning":"Register in the block at off_10C5A4 assigned value 6."},{"offset":324,"meaning":"Register in the block at off_10C5A4 assigned value 8."}]}
